caveats: NCU is comparison-only ground truth and is absent from simulator commands and profile inputs.
Cache rates are launch-global weighted rates derived from NCU hit/miss sector sums; direct per-subunit NCU .pct ratios are not used.
Every final completion frontier is an explicit lower bound with retained unmodeled retirement tails.
GPU/simulator and NCU/simulator values are named time ratios, not unqualified speedups.
Final results contain three independent application-replay NCU repeats per workload; raw repeat values remain in JSON.

formulas.gpu_execution_over_simulator_wall: sum NCU gpu__time_duration.sum seconds / sum simulator median process wall seconds
formulas.hit_rate_pct: 100 * NCU hit sectors / (hit sectors + miss sectors)
formulas.ncu_profile_wall_over_simulator_wall: sum mean NCU capture-process wall seconds / sum simulator median process wall seconds
formulas.ncu_repeat_reduction: median of independent NCU repeats; raw values, mean, min, max, and relative range retained
formulas.total_mape: launch-weighted arithmetic mean over covered launch-metric APE values
formulas.workload_mape: arithmetic mean over covered launch-metric APE values
